title: Teller deposits
description: Capture a cash or cheque deposit for a company's customer. Choose the company first: a customer code alone does not identify who is credited.
noBranch: Your access is not linked to a branch.
notFound: No active customer with this code was found for this company.
amountHint: Above <threshold></threshold> a branch manager must approve before anything is credited. Maximum <cap></cap>.
amountInvalid: Enter an amount in LYD with up to three decimals.
depositorHint: A slip or counter reference. Do not enter identity document numbers.
captureNote: Capturing does not credit the account. Cash is posted by the bank's system; a cheque is credited only after clearing.
recentEmpty: No deposits captured at this branch yet
queueDescription: Deposits above the manager threshold. Nothing is credited before your decision. You cannot decide a deposit you captured yourself.
queueEmpty: No deposit is waiting for a manager
ownIntake: You captured this deposit, so you cannot decide it. Another manager of this branch must.
cashReview: Large cash intake — flagged for review
cashReviewHelp: A review flag for the bank. It is not a regulatory report.

approval.note: Approving lets the bank's system post this deposit (cash) or accept the cheque for clearing. Check the amount against the cash or cheque in front of you.

cheques.title: Cheque clearing (simulated)
cheques.help: Send the clearing-house result for a cheque that is waiting. A duplicate or late event has no effect.
cheques.empty: No cheque is waiting for clearing
cheques.reasonReturn: Simulated return by the drawee bank
